description: This Kotlin source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android calculator app, handling UI setup, user interactions, expression evaluation, history management, and theme toggling.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Primary activity managing the calculator UI, incorporating voice input, history, undo/redo, and theme switch.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and configures event handlers.

methods.name: updateResultBox
methods.description: Updates the result display and manages undo/redo states.

methods.name: setupUndoRedoButtons
methods.description: Configures the undo and redo button click actions.

methods.name: updateUndoRedoButtonStates
methods.description: Enables or disables undo/redo buttons based on available states.

methods.name: evaluateAndShowResult
methods.description: Evaluates the current expression and displays the result, updating history.

methods.name: wireCalculatorKeypad
methods.description: Binds calculator keypad buttons to corresponding input symbols and actions.

methods.name: setupHistoryPanel
methods.description: Initializes the history drawer toggle button and overlay.

methods.name: showHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Inflates and animates the display of the history drawer.

methods.name: hideHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Animates and removes the history drawer from view.

methods.name: populateHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Populates the history drawer with calculation history, including removal and favorite toggling.

methods.name: updateHistoryPanelIfVisible
methods.description: Refreshes the history panel if it is currently visible.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for theme toggling.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Switches between day and night themes.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Delegates activity result handling to VoiceSearchBar.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Passes permission results to VoiceSearchBar for handling.
